title: ASCIIpOrtal
summary: Portal as an ASCII puzzle platformer: two portals, boulders, buttons and a lot of falling.
description: Run with the pad, climb ladders with up and down; up and down also aim. Portal fires the next portal, Blue and Yellow fire one of each, Clear removes them. Fling yourself through the test chambers: over 200 levels in many map packs (Change Map Set in the menu).

verification.notes: Host test in a PTY at 80x24: title, menu, the first test chamber, moving. Built without SDL or sound; fixed two functions that fell off their end (the game crashed on loading a map).
